sentences.en: I was fined six thousand yen for a parking violation.
sentences.zh: 因为我违停被罚款六千日元。

sentences.en: They said it was a clear violation of international law.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是明显违反国际法的行为。

sentences.en: Arbitrary detention is the violation of the right to liberty.
sentences.zh: 任意拘留是对人身自由权的侵犯。

senses.zh: （对法律、协议、原则等的）违背，违反；侵权行为，（对人权的）侵犯；（对某物的）损毁，（对圣地的）亵渎；强奸
